## Setup
```{r}
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textstats)
library(stringr)
library(tidytext)
library(tidyr)
```


# I. Raw-Count Sentiment Analysis (Week 03 Method)

## Step 1
```{r}
file_a <- "texts/A07594__Circle_of_Commerce.txt"
file_b <- "texts/B14801__Free_Trade.txt"

text_a <- read_file(file_a)
text_b <- read_file(file_b)

texts <- tibble(
  doc_title = c("Text A", "Text B"),
  text = c(text_a, text_b)
)
```

```{r}
data("stop_words")

custom_stopwords <- tibble(
  word = c(
    "vnto", "haue", "doo", "hath", "bee", "ye", "thee",
    "hee", "shall", "hast", "doe", "beene", "thereof", "thus"
  )
)

all_stopwords <- bind_rows(stop_words, custom_stopwords) %>%
  distinct(word)

tokens_clean <- texts %>%
  mutate(text = str_replace_all(text, "ſ", "s")) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  mutate(word = str_to_lower(word)) %>%
  anti_join(all_stopwords, by = "word")

tokens_clean
```

## Step 2
```{r}
bing_sentiments <- get_sentiments("bing")

tokens_sentiment <- tokens_clean %>%
  inner_join(bing_sentiments, by = "word")

tokens_sentiment
```

## Step 3
```{r}
raw_sentiment_totals <- tokens_sentiment %>%
  group_by(doc_title) %>%
  summarise(
    positive = sum(sentiment == "positive"),
    negative = sum(sentiment == "negative"),
    net_sentiment = positive - negative
  )

raw_sentiment_totals
```

# II. TF-IDF–Weighted Sentiment Analysis 

## Step 4
```{r}
txt_circle    <- read_file("texts/A07594__Circle_of_Commerce.txt")
txt_free      <- read_file("texts/B14801__Free_Trade.txt")
txt_third     <- read_file("texts/A06785.txt")

texts_2 <- c(
  "Circle_of_Commerce" = txt_circle,
  "Free_Trade"         = txt_free,
  "Third_Text_A06785"  = txt_third
)

texts_2 <- str_replace_all(texts_2, "ſ", "s")

corp <- corpus(texts_2)

toks <- tokens(
  corp,
  remove_punct   = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE,
  remove_symbols = TRUE
)

toks <- tokens_tolower(toks)

custom_stop <- c(
  "vnto", "haue", "doo", "hath", "bee", "ye", "thee", "hee", "shall", "hast",
  "doe", "beene", "thereof", "thus"
)

toks <- tokens_remove(toks, pattern = c(stopwords("en"), custom_stop))

dfm_mat <- dfm(toks)

dfm_tfidf <- dfm_tfidf(dfm_mat)

dfm_tfidf
```
## Step 5
```{r}
tfidf_df <- convert(dfm_tfidf, to = "data.frame")

tfidf_tidy <- tfidf_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -doc_id,
    names_to = "word",
    values_to = "tfidf"
  ) %>%
  filter(tfidf > 0) %>%
  filter(doc_id %in% c("Circle_of_Commerce", "Free_Trade"))

tfidf_tidy
```

## Step 6
```{r}
tfidf_sentiment <- tfidf_tidy %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word") %>%
  arrange(doc_id, desc(tfidf))

tfidf_sentiment %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  slice_max(tfidf, n = 10) %>%
  arrange(doc_id, desc(tfidf))
```

## Step 7
```{r}
tfidf_sentiment_summary <- tfidf_sentiment %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  summarise(
    positive = sum(tfidf[sentiment == "positive"]),
    negative = sum(tfidf[sentiment == "negative"]),
    net_tfidf_sentiment = positive - negative
  )

tfidf_sentiment_summary
```

# III. Compare Raw vs. TF-IDF Sentiment
```{r}
raw_sentiment_totals_clean <- raw_sentiment_totals %>%
  mutate(
    doc_id = case_when(
      doc_title == "Text A" ~ "Circle_of_Commerce",
      doc_title == "Text B" ~ "Free_Trade",
      TRUE ~ doc_title
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    raw_positive = positive,
    raw_negative = negative,
    raw_net_sentiment = net_sentiment
  )

tfidf_sentiment_summary_clean <- tfidf_sentiment_summary %>%
  rename(
    tfidf_positive = positive,
    tfidf_negative = negative,
    tfidf_net_sentiment = net_tfidf_sentiment
  )

final_sentiment_comparison <- raw_sentiment_totals_clean %>%
  left_join(
    tfidf_sentiment_summary_clean,
    by = "doc_id"
  )

final_sentiment_comparison
```
```{r}
write_csv(final_sentiment_comparison, "sentiment_comparison.csv")
```
